title: Nano State Block
description: Schema for a Nano universal state block (v1), which is the current block format for all transactions on the Nano network.

type.description: Block type — always 'state' for universal blocks

account.description: The account that owns this block

previous.description: Hash of the previous block in this account's chain; all zeros for open blocks

representative.description: The voting representative for this account

balance.description: Account balance after this block in raw units

link.description: For send blocks: destination account public key; for receive blocks: hash of the send block being received; for change/epoch blocks: related hash or zero

link_as_account.description: Link field interpreted as an account address (send destination)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature of the block hash, signed by the account's private key

work.description: Proof-of-work nonce satisfying the difficulty threshold

subtype.description: Semantic subtype of the state block
